summary: The run-ETA backfill reads each step definition's own runs and each step's own person asks, so the first open after the run-ETA windows takes under a second instead of minutes

replay.detail: The same candidates and holds are read, so the same samples result. Rebuild and large dirty flushes get faster in the same way.

schema.detail: Add step_runs_definition_index on step_runs(definition_hash, run_id, generation_id) with CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. It is built once on the first open (0.05 s for 24,692 step runs) and leaves the schema cookie alone on later opens.

rules.detail: The window bounds and the sample rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire fields, claim kinds or serving schemas change. An older build ignores the extra index.

downtime.detail: A store that has not yet opened on a run-ETA v3 build now pays under a second on its first open instead of minutes (172 s and 190 s on two production stores). A store that already ran the v3 backfill only builds the index.

recovery.detail: Rollback leaves an unused index; the samples are unchanged.
